Skill Assessment Tools for Gardening:

1. Plant Growth Log: Track height, leaf count, and flowering stages over time to assess knowledge of plant development cycles.
2. Pest Management Record: Document identified pests, treatments applied, and effectiveness to evaluate problem-solving and integrated pest management skills.
3. Harvest Yield Tracker: Record quantity and quality of produce per plant or season to measure productivity and efficiency.
4. Soil and Care Journal: Note watering schedules, fertilizer types, and soil conditions to monitor consistency and understanding of plant needs.
5. Seasonal Planning Review: Compare planned vs. actual planting dates and outcomes to assess strategic planning and adaptability.
